classes.desc: WHERE with top-level AND / OR, one condition per line
WHERE mixing AND / OR with parenthesised groups that stay on one line
WHERE NOT applied to a parenthesised group
WHERE .. BETWEEN .. AND .., the inner AND stays on the line
WHERE with string and number literals
WHERE with function calls in conditions
tokenizer: numbers, strings, escaped quotes, negative numbers
tokenizer: comparison and arithmetic operators, * as Star vs Operator

cases.name: two conditions with AND, column name is not a keyword
cases.sql: SELECT * FROM table_name WHERE id = 1 and name = 'ABC'

cases.name: three conditions with AND
cases.sql: select * from orders where status='paid' and amount>100 and created_at >= '2026-01-01'

cases.name: OR
cases.sql: select * from t where a = 1 or b = 2

cases.name: NOT with AND
cases.sql: select * from users where not is_deleted and active = 1

cases.name: group then AND
cases.sql: select * from t where (a = 1 and b = 2 or c = 3) and d = 4

cases.name: nested groups
cases.sql: select * from t where ((a = 1 and b = 2) or c = 3) and d = 4

cases.name: AND then group
cases.sql: select * from t where a = 1 and (b = 2 or c = 3)

cases.name: two groups and OR
cases.sql: select * from t where ( a = 1 or b = 2 ) and ( c = 3 or d = 4 ) or e = 5

cases.name: three levels of nesting
cases.sql: select * from t where (((a = 1 or b = 2) and c = 3) or d = 4) and e = 5
format_want: WHERE  (((a = 1 OR b = 2) AND c = 3) OR d = 4)

cases.name: between numbers
cases.sql: select * from orders where amount between 10 and 20

cases.name: between dates then AND
cases.sql: select * from orders where created_at between '2026-01-01' and '2026-12-31' and status = 'paid'

cases.name: not between
cases.sql: select * from orders where amount not between 10 and 20

cases.name: not in strings then AND
cases.sql: select * from users where country not in ( 'US', 'CA' ) and active = 1

cases.name: long list stays on one line
not group
cases.sql: select * from t where not (a = 1 or b = 2)

cases.name: AND not nested group
cases.sql: select * from t where a = 1 and not ((b = 2 and c = 3) or d = 4)
format_want: AND NOT ((b = 2 AND c = 3) OR d = 4)

cases.name: function on column
cases.sql: select * from users where lower(email) = 'a@example.com'

cases.name: nested functions with AND
cases.sql: select * from users where length( trim(last_name) ) > 0 and coalesce(age,0) >= 18

cases.name: star after a value is multiply
cases.sql: select * from order_items where price*quantity > 100

cases.name: divide, add and modulo
cases.sql: select * from orders where amount/2+10 >= total and id%2 = 0

cases.name: unary sign after multiply
cases.sql: select a * -1 from t where b*+2 > 0

cases.name: unary minus and subtraction
cases.sql: select * from accounts where balance > -5 and balance - 5 < 100

cases.name: negative number is an operator and a number
string
cases.sql: 'paid'

cases.name: string keeps case, spaces and keywords
cases.sql: 'Select FROM  x'

cases.name: string with escaped quote
cases.sql: 'it''s here'

cases.name: arithmetic operators
cases.sql: a + b - c / d % e

cases.name: star is a Star as a wildcard and an Operator after a value
cases.sql: select *, count(*), price*qty, (a)*2, 3*-1
